title: Main project structure based on the graphiti library
description:
There's a library `https://github.com/getzep/graphiti` that provides an upgraded RAG database - a knowledge graph. This project needs to be able to run locally and must expose an API that any client can interact with.
For reference, the whole library has been added under `graphiti/` .

features.title: Initialize Project with Poetry and Basic Files
features.description: Set up the basic project structure by initializing a new Poetry project. This will create the `pyproject.toml` for dependency management. Also, add a standard Python `.gitignore` file and a placeholder `README.md`.

features.title: Add Core Dependencies (graphiti, fastapi, uvicorn)
features.description: Use Poetry to add the core libraries required for the project. This includes `graphiti-python` for the knowledge graph, `fastapi` for building the API, and `uvicorn` for serving the application.

features.title: Set Up Application Source Directory Structure
features.description: Create a `src/` directory to contain the main application code.

features.title: Implement Basic FastAPI Application with Health Check
features.description: Create a `main.py` inside `src/`. In this file, initialize a FastAPI application and implement a `/health` GET endpoint that returns a 200 OK status. This serves as the application's entry point and a basic way to verify it's running.

features.title: Create a Service for Graphiti Knowledge Graph
features.description: Create a new module `src/graph_service.py` to handle all interactions with the `graphiti` library. Implement an initialization function or class to set up the knowledge graph instance. This will centralize graph-related logic.

features.title: Create API Endpoint to Add Data to the Graph
features.description: Implement a POST endpoint (e.g., `/documents`) in `main.py`. This endpoint will accept a payload containing text data, use the `GraphService` to process and add the data to the knowledge graph, and return a success response.

features.title: Create API Endpoint to Query the Graph
features.description: Implement a GET endpoint (e.g., `/query`) in `main.py`. This endpoint will accept a query string, use the `GraphService` to search the knowledge graph, and return the relevant results.

features.title: Add Docker Support for Local Execution
features.description: Create a `Dockerfile` to containerize the FastAPI application. Also, create a `docker-compose.yml` file to define the application service, making it easy to build and run the entire project locally with a single command.

features.title: Implement Configuration Management
features.description: Create a `config.py` module to manage application settings using environment variables (e.g., via Pydantic's BaseSettings). This will handle configurations like API port, logging levels, and any specific settings for the graphiti library.

features.title: Update README with Setup and Usage Instructions
features.description: Flesh out the `README.md` file with a project description, detailed instructions on how to set up the environment (both natively with Poetry and with Docker), how to run the application, and examples of how to use the API endpoints.

features.title: The graphiti library isn't used correctly
features.description:
For this story, especially useful is the @graphiti/README.md . The imported package are actually all the files under `graphiti/graphiti-core`. These files are there just for reference - the package must be used properly like it is imported now in the @pyproject.toml .
Go over the @src/graph_service.py and fix the usage so that it is correct and aligns with this story's requirements.

features.title: The project depends on neo4j - explain how to create it and run locally
features.description: Explain the exact steps the user must follow from scratch so that they can have this running and serving clients over the REST API - all in @README.md .
